class.name: ScrollListener
class.brief_description: Receives scroll step deltas and scroll-state changes.
class.description:
ScrollListener is the port of [i]RecyclerView.OnScrollListener[/i]. Register an instance with [method RecyclerView.add_on_scroll_listener]; subclass it and override [method _on_scrolled] / [method _on_scroll_state_changed] to react to scrolling.
[b]Example[/b]: [codeblock] class L extends ScrollListener: func _on_scrolled(dx: int, dy: int) -> void: print("scrolled by ", dx, ", ", dy)
func _on_scroll_state_changed(state: int) -> void: if state == RecyclerView.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE: print("stopped") [/codeblock]
In a reverse layout the reported [code]dy[/code] follows the content: positive means the content moved down, matching the Android semantics.

method.name: _on_scroll_state_changed
method.description: Called when the scroll state changes to [constant RecyclerView.SCROLL_STATE_IDLE], [constant RecyclerView.SCROLL_STATE_DRAGGING] or [constant RecyclerView.SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING].

method.name: _on_scrolled
method.description: Called on every scroll step with the horizontal / vertical delta since the last call.

method.name: on_scroll_state_changed
method.description: C++ forwarding shell for [method _on_scroll_state_changed]; scripts override the underscore version.

method.name: on_scrolled
method.description: C++ forwarding shell for [method _on_scrolled]; scripts override the underscore version.
